That surface is relevant to TB-003 (local operator vs process) and TB-002/T-053 (register and drain lifecycle). Integration should check whether the corresponding source changes are in other batches and whether the threat model needs a new boundary for the local add-on IPC peer. Specific points to verify: peer authentication; socket permissions; oversized-line limits; that a planned reconnect cannot reopen serving while held; and that busy fields leak no prompt data. No security regression is evidenced by documentation alone, so no findings are reported.
